data.name: Clarance
data.gender_notes: Clarance is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'clarus', meaning 'glory' or 'renowned'. This name was given to children born to bring honour and glory to their families. The name Clarance carries the meaning “Glory of the son” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Clarance usually hope their child will grow to embody glory of the son and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the glory of God, reflecting the divine light within.
data.etymology: Clarance belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glory of the son.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Clarance total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: קלארנס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קלארנס מקורו בשם הלטיני קלרנציוס, שפירושו ברור או צלול. הוא קשור למילה הלטינית 'קלרוס', שפירושו ברור או מפורסם. השם נמצא בשימוש הנוצרי ומשויך לתכונות של בהירות ופירוש.

in_greek.name: Κλαράνς
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Κλαράνς είναι παράγωγο του λατινικού ονόματος Clarentius, που σημαίνει σαφής ή φωτεινός. Είναι συνδεδεμένος με τη λατινική λέξη 'clarus', που σημαίνει σαφής ή περίφημος. Το όνομα χρησιμοποιείται στην χριστιανική παράδοση και συνδέεται με τις ιδιότητες της σαφήνειας και της φήμης.

in_english.meaning: Clear, bright, or famous; a name symbolizing clarity and renown
